tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start here — Phoenix OS in one page. README.md gives the pitch, build instructions, and the key-files index. HANDOFF.md (3483 lines) is the running developer journal covering every boot milestone from boot1 through boot100+: WIMP desktop, FileCore, TCP/IP stack, I2C RTC, FAT32, DMA4, DrawFile, WimpDemo. THIRD-PARTY.md tracks licence provenance.

tour.title: Build System & Memory Map
tour.description: The Makefile drives the aarch64-linux-gnu cross-compiler, board-specific targets (Pi4/Pi5), and always-fresh build stamp. kernel/Makefile compiles all .c and .S in kernel/ and links via linker.ld. The linker script is the authoritative memory map: __svc_stack_base/__svc_stack_top (64KB #147 stack), __kernel_stack_top, section boundaries for BSS zeroing, and the entry-point symbol primary_cpu_entry. config.txt / config-pi5.txt set GPU RAM, UART, HDMI and CMOS base address at boot.

tour.title: AArch64 Boot Stub
tour.description: primary_cpu_entry (boot.S) is the first instruction executed. It drops from EL2 to EL1, fixes Pi5 timer registers (cnthctl_el2, cntvoff_el2), enables MMU and caches, zeroes BSS, and calls kernel_main. secondary_cpu_entry parks non-boot CPUs. The AIF loader (aif.c) is layered on top: aif_run loads RISC OS AIF images, aif_jump manages the SVC privilege ceiling (#147), gos_run_supervisor runs GOS-style supervisor mode for loaded modules.

tour.title: Exception Vectors & SVC Dispatch
tour.description: exceptions.S installs the AArch64 exception vector table. exc_sync_handler dispatches SVC (SWI), data aborts, and instruction aborts. The dedicated 64KB SVC stack (#147) is nesting-aware: aif.c switches SP on entry/exit and tracks depth in g_svc_ceiling to prevent stack collisions between nested SWI calls. vec_call.S implements OS_CallAVector, OS_Claim, OS_Release with tombstone GC for safe chain-walking.

tour.title: kernel_main: The Boot Sequence
tour.description: kernel_main (kernel.c, 681 lines) is the fully sequential boot script — it calls every subsystem init in dependency order: devicetree_init, pci_init, mmc_init, filecore_init, module_init_all, then enters the idle/WIMP event pump (input_pump). init_process creates the first user-mode process. lib.c provides debug_print, vsnprintf, and the net_pump / wimp_task idle hooks called from input_pump.

tour.title: Device Tree, PCIe & HAL
tour.description: devicetree.c parses the Pi FDT blob to discover GIC, memory, CPUs, and I2C buses (volatile byte reads to defeat -O2 load-merging). pci.c enumerates PCIe using ECAM — BCM2711 VL805 xHCI on Pi4, Pi5 RP1 xHCI on pcie0, NVMe M.2 on pcie1. HALInfo provider module (SWI 0x5D000) exposes CPU type, peripheral base, GIC config, and timer rates via the SWI interface. BoardInfo (SWI 0x5C000) reads Pi revision/serial/RAM from the VideoCore mailbox.

tour.title: Hardware Drivers: USB, SDIO & Input
tour.description: DWC2 host controller (usb_dwc2.c: split-transaction support for LS/FS devices behind HS hubs, self-contained USB host stack). USB HID class driver (usb_hid.c: keyboard/mouse, xHCI-side). input_stub.c bridges raw HID events into Phoenix input event queue for the WIMP manager. SDIO WiFi stack: sdio_wifi.c (WPA2 join/DHCP/CLM upload, SDPCM/BCDC transport), sdio.c (Arasan SDHCI, CMD52/CMD53), sdio_fw.c (firmware download to CYW43455), sdhci_brcmstb.c (Pi5 RP1 SDHCI glue: GPIO mux, WL_ON). BT UART driver (bt_uart.c: CYW43455 HCI-over-UART).

tour.title: Storage: MMC, DMA4, FileCore & FAT32
tour.description: mmc.c is the SDHCI MMC/SD host controller driver (337-line mmc_init, PIO block I/O). dma4.c is the BCM DMA4 engine (cyclic streaming channels, cache coherency, mem-mem test). filecore.c (4576 lines) is the RISC OS FileCore port: ADFS new-map disc parsing, NVMe 4K-native, MBR/GPT partition scan, path resolution, ADFS chain traversal, save/open, Obey script interpreter, module loader (step6). fat32.c is Phoenix second filesystem: full FAT32 with CMOS persistence on the FAT partition. DiscInfo provider (SWI 0x5E000) reports disc geometry.

tour.title: FileSwitch, Vectors & Module System
tour.description: fileswitch.c is the RISC OS FileSwitch multiplexer: routes fs_find/gbpb/args/control/file to whichever filing system is registered (FileCore, FAT32, testfs). fs_call.S is the AArch64 assembly veneer for making FileSwitch entry calls from C. module.c (2296 lines) implements the RISC OS module system: load from memory, register, broadcast_service, SWI dispatch (swi_dispatch routes 0x00-0x60000+), command dispatcher, boot init chain. vectors.c: OS_Claim/Release/CallAVector with tombstone GC. dynarea.c: OS_DynamicArea create/delete/resize/query.

tour.title: The SWI Table: os_swi.c
tour.description: os_swi.c (6268 lines) is the heart of Phoenix — a single os_swi_handler routing every RISC OS SWI to its implementation: OS_Write*/Read*, OS_File, OS_Find, OS_GBPB, OS_Args, OS_FSControl, OS_DynamicArea, OS_ReadVarVal/SetVarVal/GSTrans, OS_ServiceCall, OS_Claim/Release/CallAVector, all Wimp SWIs, VDU SWIs, Font SWIs, Sound SWIs, I2C SWIs, Network SWIs, Clock SWIs, Dynamic Area SWIs. The provider SWI chunks (0x5A000-0x60000) are also dispatched here. input_pump is the idle/event polling loop at the bottom of kernel_main.

tour.title: Networking: Full TCP/IP Stack
tour.description: Phoenix has a complete bare-metal TCP/IP stack in net/: arp.c (ARP request/reply, MAC resolution table), ipv4.c (IPv4 packet routing, fragmentation, ICMP), tcpip.c (TCP SYN/ACK state machine, retransmit), udp.c (UDP sockets), dhcp.c (DHCP DISCOVER/OFFER/REQUEST/ACK client), ntp.c (NTP client, UDP port 123, updates OS clock), resolver_module.c (DNS, RISC OS SWI interface). rp1_gem.c is the Pi5 RP1 gigabit Ethernet MAC driver (DMA ring, TX/RX, link state). WiFiCtl (0x5B000) and Ifconfig (0x5F000) modules expose WiFi/IP config via SWIs.

tour.title: I2C Bus & DS3231M RTC
tour.description: i2c.c implements the BSC-based I2C master for Pi 4/5 with full Device Tree bus discovery. The DS3231M real-time clock at address 0x68 is the key client: ds3231_boot_adopt reads the hardware clock at boot and sets the Phoenix OS clock, closing the loop between hardware time and OS_ReadMonotonicTime. i2c_bus_transfer provides a generic SWI-callable I2C transfer API for other modules. This feeds RTC_PLAN.md which documents the complete RTC subsystem design.

tour.title: GPU, Framebuffer & VDU Subsystem
tour.description: mailbox_property.c implements the VideoCore IV property mailbox protocol (screen resolution, framebuffer allocation, GPU memory queries, MAC address). framebuffer.c/h allocate the VideoCore framebuffer, provide RGB565 pixel ops, scrolling text console, and software cursor. gpu.c orchestrates boot-time display setup. vdu.c is the OS_WriteC hot path: buffers multi-byte VDU sequences (VDU 4/5/24/26) before dispatching to the graphics layer. graf_prims.c provides low-level plot/line/rect/clip primitives and the ColourTrans module. spriteop.c handles sprite switching via vdu_set_graphics_window. sound.c and hdmi_audio.c provide audio output.

tour.title: WIMP Manager & Desktop Layer
tour.description: wimp_mod.c (1847 lines) is the WIMP manager: bridges RISC OS Wimp SWIs (Wimp_Initialise, Wimp_Poll, Wimp_OpenWindow, Wimp_CreateWindow, Wimp_RedrawWindow, Wimp_CreateIcon, Wimp_SetColour) to the Phoenix framebuffer. wimp_swi is a 780-line SWI switch dispatcher. font.c provides Font_FindFont/Paint/Lose. cursor_module_impl.c is the software cursor module (pointer sprite on VDU). WIMP_PORT_PLAN.md and WIMP_SPEC.md document the desktop layer design.

tour.title: WIMP Applications: WimpDemo, HIDDemo & DrawFile
tour.description: WimpDemo-phoenix is the first complete RISC OS Wimp application running on Phoenix: do_demo wires Wimp_Initialise → CreateWindow → OpenWindow → three CreateIcon → Poll, do_run runs the full event loop, LP64-safe SWI wrappers guard all AArch64 casting hazards. HIDDemo-phoenix tests USB HID: do_mousetest (OS_Mouse), do_keytest (OS_Byte-129 INKEY), do_videovtest (VideoV vector chain end-to-end from C). DrawFile-phoenix ports the RISC OS DrawFile module (SWI &45540: Render/BBox/DeclareFonts): walk() traverses Draw object lists, render_path() does fill+stroke two-pass rendering.

tour.title: Bluetooth & Provider Modules Suite
tour.description: Seven provider modules form Phoenix's extended SWI namespace (0x5A000–0x60000): BTUart (0x5A000: CYW43455 HCI-over-UART, *BTScan/*BTPair, bt_uart.c driver), WiFiCtl (0x5B000: scan/join/leave, wraps sdio_wifi.c), BoardInfo (0x5C000: board model/revision/RAM), HALInfo (0x5D000: CPU/periph base/GIC), DiscInfo (0x5E000: disc geometry/capacity), Ifconfig (0x5F000: IP/netmask/gateway/DNS config), XHCIInfo (0x60000: USB device enumeration, *USBInfo, Pi5 trackpad counters). All follow the same pattern: CMHG header + C implementation + module_register() at boot.

tour.title: Tools, Testing & Conformance
tour.description: tools/hosttest/ contains host-side (Linux/Mac) harnesses that test individual Phoenix subsystems without hardware: framebuffer_harness.c, vdu_harness.c, descriptor_harness.c, messagefile_harness.c, etc. tools/conform/roconform.py runs RISC OS conformance tests comparing Phoenix SWI outputs against real RISC OS. tools/moddiff.py compares RISC OS module binaries; modreloc.py investigates whether 64-bit string relocations work correctly (the boot171 lesson). tools/build-*.sh scripts fetch upstream RISC OS sources and apply Phoenix patches.

tour.title: Design Docs & Engineering Journal
tour.description: docs/journal.txt is the master engineering log (boot572+), documenting every major decision from boot65-75a (Pi5 complete) through boot100+ (WIMP desktop push). GOTCHAS.md (3030 lines, 95 sections) is the LP64/AArch64 pitfall catalogue. MODULAR_ARCHITECTURE.md and MODULE_ADOPTION_PLAN.md document the module system. MULTICORE_PLAN.md (6 staged milestones) and EXC_IRQ_STACK_PLAN.md cover SMP. APP_LAUNCH_CHAIN.md and BUILDING_A_MODULE.md guide application developers. RESOURCEFS_PORT_PLAN.md and RTC_PLAN.md have hardware measurement results.

project.name: Phoenix OS
project.description: AArch64 bare-metal OS for Raspberry Pi 4/CM4/Pi5. RISC OS-inspired with native module system, full SWI dispatch table, RISC OS FileCore+FileSwitch, FAT32, complete TCP/IP stack (ARP/IPv4/TCP/UDP/DHCP/NTP/DNS), WIMP desktop manager, VDU/graphics subsystem, USB DWC2+xHCI, MMC/SDIO WiFi, Bluetooth UART, I2C/RTC, DMA4, seven provider modules (BTUart/WiFiCtl/BoardInfo/HALInfo/DiscInfo/Ifconfig/XHCIInfo, SWI 0x5A000-0x60000), and first working RISC OS applications (WimpDemo, HIDDemo, DrawFile).
